title: Fix UI Bugs, Permissions, and Auto-Update Logic
description: Resolved multiple frontend and backend issues including empty Gantt rows, failed status updates due to UUID permission mismatch, local CORS dev errors, incorrect overdue badges, and broken project auto-update logic.

revisions.summary: Implemented fixes across gantt.ts, permissions.ts, next.config.ts, DepartmentProjects.tsx, and taskUpdater.ts

completed: gantt.ts - Fixed dummy task ID mismatch causing empty rows in GanttTaskListTable
permissions.ts - Enhanced canEditTask to support UUID mapping for users, fixing 'Failed to update status' errors
next.config.ts - Added allowedDevOrigins to fix local HMR CORS issues
DepartmentProjects.tsx - Hid 'ด่วน' (Overdue) badge if project progress is 100%
taskUpdater.ts - Fixed project lookup to use OR condition for ID or project_code, fixing silent failure of auto-updates

key_context.dummy_tasks: Gantt dummy task must match 'dummy-padding-task' ID perfectly to be hidden.
key_context.permissions: assignee_id is stored as UUID, requiring mapping instead of email lookup.
key_context.task_updater: projectId passed to taskUpdater can be either UUID or project_code depending on legacy state.
